description: This file contains functions for importing notes and notebooks, processing attachments, and managing related database operations within the Notesnook project.

methods.name: importNote
methods.description: Main function to import a note, processing attachments and related data.

methods.name: processAttachments
methods.description: Processes and encrypts attachments, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: processNote
methods.description: Processes note content, tags, colors, notebooks, and stores the note in the database.

methods.name: importNotebook
methods.description: Recursively imports notebooks and their children, returning their IDs.
